_README: S4's frozen expected-break fixture (acceptance.md:65, epics.md:836).
HAND-CHECKED ONCE AND THEN NEVER REGENERATED TO MAKE A TEST PASS.
There is no generator for this file, deliberately: nothing in this repository
can write it. `words` is the LABEL - the segmentation a reader would make - and
`expectedBreaks` is its arithmetic: the cumulative rune lengths of every word
but the last. Check the WORDS; the numbers follow. Positions are RUNE indices.
Every item is whitespace-free, so each break is zero-width and one position says
everything about it.
A BREAK OPPORTUNITY IS NOT AN ETYMOLOGY. The first draft of this fixture split
thai-003..thai-010 into their historical morphemes - school as hall+study, train
as vehicle+fire - and labelled each seam as a break. That was wrong. Every one of
those eight is a single dictionary HEADWORD, and a reader no more breaks inside
them than an English reader breaks 'notebook' after 'note'. The labels were
corrected to one word each, on evidence independent of the engine's output
(headword membership in the shipped wordlist), and the eight now serve as the
fixture's negative controls: a lexicalised compound is NOT split. thai-001 and
thai-002 are the contrast - sequences that are NOT headwords, though both of
their parts are, and which therefore DO carry a break.
STATUS: authored by the Story 2.4 dev agent. The human hand-check is a SEPARATE,
PENDING Epic 2 gate obligation, bound to this file's own digest (D-2.4.3) and
distinct from the Thai RENDERING sign-off in fixtures/shaped-text/. A re-record
of either must invalidate exactly one of them.
